issues.description: The problem text explicitly asks students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but both the template and the provided solution declare this helper as private. Additionally, the UML in the problem statement shows the method as private (contradicting the textual instruction). This visibility mismatch between the textual instruction, the UML, and the code (template & solution) can confuse students and may cause tests or grading code that expects a public helper to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility inconsistency: either (A) change the helper method in both the template and solution to public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update the UML to mark the method as public, matching the textual instruction; or (B) if the helper should remain private, update the problem text to remove the instruction to make it public and clarify that tests will not require a public helper.
